text.v: 2 - Số dư giảm dần có điều chỉnh

command.text: declare @size int = col_length('dmts', 'so_the_ts'), @size2 int = col_length('dmts', 'ten_ts')/2 select 'this.getItem(''so_the_ts'').maxLength = ' + rtrim(@size) + ';this.getItem(''ten_ts'').maxLength = ' + rtrim(@size2) as message return

declare @baseCurrency&Controller; varchar(32), @method&Controller; char(1) select @method&Controller; = rtrim(val) from options where name = 'm_ts_kh' select @baseCurrency&Controller; = rtrim(val) from options where name = 'm_ma_nt0'
select 'this._baseCurrency&Controller;=''' + @baseCurrency&Controller; + ''';this.$_method&Controller; = ' + @method&Controller; + ';active$Form&Controller;(this);onChange&Controller;$Currency(this);' as message return

action.text: if exists(select 1 from dmttndts where ma_pl_ts = @ma_pl_ts and status = '1') begin select a.kieu_kh, a.so_ky_kh, tl_kh00, rtrim(a.ma_phi) ma_phi, rtrim(a.loai_ts) loai_ts, b.ten_loai%l ten_loai_ts, rtrim(a.ma_tg_ts) ma_tg_ts, c.ten_tg_ts%l ten_tg_ts, rtrim(a.tk_ts) tk_ts, isnull(d.ten_tk%l, '') ten_tk_ts, rtrim(a.tk_kh) tk_kh, isnull(e.ten_tk%l, '') ten_tk_kh, rtrim(a.ma_nv) ma_nv, f.ten_nv%l ten_nv from dmttndts a with(nolock) left join dmplts b with(nolock) on a.loai_ts = b.ma_loai left join dmtgts c with(nolock) on a.ma_tg_ts = c.ma_tg_ts left join dmtk d with(nolock) on a.tk_ts = d.tk and d.loai_tk = 1 left join dmtk e with(nolock) on a.tk_kh = e.tk and e.loai_tk = 1 left join dmnv f with(nolock) on a.ma_nv = f.ma_nv where a.ma_pl_ts = @ma_pl_ts and a.status = '1' return end
